job.rawJd: Principal UX / Human-Centered Design Lead. We are seeking a senior Principal UX / Human-Centered Design Lead for a User Experience Design Consultant opportunity. This is a fractional senior role, not a full-time staffing role. The consultant must be strong enough to be named as key personnel in the proposal and, if awarded, lead UX discovery, service design, research planning, and design recommendations for a public long-term care benefits program. Core role: Serve as the lead UX/HCD authority for the engagement. Guide discovery, user research, stakeholder engagement, journey mapping, wireframes, usability testing, accessibility-aware design, and strategic UX planning. Required background: At least 3 years of UX, HCD, CX, or digital experience consulting within the last 5 years. At least 2 major projects within the last 5 years involving UX, CX, digital transformation, or customer journey work. Experience in government, healthcare, health and human services, long-term care, social services, insurance, public benefits, or another regulated service environment. Experience with user research, stakeholder interviews, journey mapping, wireframes, usability testing, and digital service improvement. Ability to translate policy, privacy, accessibility, operational, and legal constraints into practical user experience recommendations. Ability to work with a small fractional team and participate in a state-agency interview if requested. Strong preference for public-sector benefits experience; health and human services experience; long-term care, aging, disability, caregiver, or Medicaid-related experience; accessibility-aware UX design including WCAG 2.2 familiarity; experience designing for older adults, caregivers, people with disabilities, or low-friction public access; experience with No Wrong Door, service navigation, eligibility, provider search, or complex public-service journeys; and comfort with AI-supported service design where human oversight, explainability, and trust are important. Responsibilities: Lead UX discovery and assessment; help define the Phase 1 project plan; review existing digital properties and user journeys; plan stakeholder interviews and user research; create or guide journey maps, service design artifacts, wireframes, and UX recommendations; support user testing of mockups or live software; support usability and accessibility-informed design review; help prioritize future UX deliverables; and make recommendations practical for DSHS, WA Cares users, and public-sector delivery constraints. Proposal support needed now: targeted resume focused on relevant UX/HCD work from the last 5 years and two short project summaries showing regulated-sector UX/HCD experience. This is not a visual designer-only, Figma production, proposal writing, technical writing, or AI strategy-only role. No third parties.
